# KFactory

> Python framework for photonic and electronic chip layout, built on KLayout's C++ geometry engine.

KFactory provides parametric cells with caching, optical and electrical routing, enclosures via Minkowski sums, and schematic-driven design with LVS. Lengths are integer database units (DBU) on `KCell` and float µm on `DKCell`.
